item.title: I just got to visit the first ever AR glasses pop-up experience where regular shoppers had the chance to try the future of augmented real...
item.dc:creator: nathie
item.content:encoded:
I just got to visit the first ever AR glasses pop-up experience where regular shoppers had the chance to try the future of augmented reality with SPECS.
Pop-ups like this might be the future of how we introduce people to wearable tech letting them discover it in a familiar place.

item.content:encoded: Some of the hardware is already here but VR has always been about content being king. With people from all walks of life finally able to create their own mods and experiences with AI, I have a feeling we may have found the missing puzzle piece.
